core.description: Core — a GestureProvider follows every finger of each Gesture, with motion values, and hands it to every enabled useGesture in the nested GestureZones that hear it. It never says what a Gesture means.

touch-input listens to the page and holds the browser back on each zone, leaving Native Scrolls their touches; zone follows the fingers, walks up the zones to find who hears each Gesture, and puts it together for React. Whether a release clicks is the browser's call unless a listener prevents it

recognizers.description: Recognizers — one generic meaning read from a Gesture, such as a Swipe: Possible, then Tracking with live values for feedback, then a Commit or a Cancel. They never know about each other.
Each Recognizer reads Pointers from useGesture on its own.

patterns.description: Patterns — purpose-built touch behaviours an app uses as they are, built from Recognizers, giving exactly the values their UI needs and settling themselves.
Each Pattern stands alone on the Recognizers.

facade.description: Facade — the package root: the provider and zone every hook needs, and the Patterns. Core and Recognizers are their own entry points.

use-gesture.description: The root entry re-exports the provider, the zone and the Patterns; lower layers never import higher ones.
